plugin_desc: Topvision CCMTS and EPON access-device SNMP child template for devices under enterprise PEN 32285. Beyond the shared Access SNMP floor for MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic, it walks the CCMTS system table for CPU, RAM and Flash ratios and the EPON board table for per-slot CPU, memory, and temperature. CCMTS versus EPON is selected by sysObjectID prefix or by which table returns rows, so the two trees are not averaged together blindly. Absent EPON slots that return 0 are skipped. Optional CCMTS equipment temperatures, EPON PSU AC temperature and fan speed in rps are collected when present. HOST-RESOURCES, UCD and DOCS-IF SNR are not used as private health. Supported brands/models - Topvision CCMTS and EPON access devices that expose the private health tables under 1.3.6.1.4.1.32285.11.
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Device CPU utilization from Topvision CCMTS topCcmtsSysCPURatio (0-100) or EPON board topSysBdCPUUseRatio (1-100), averaged across indexed rows. CCMTS and EPON trees are not mixed on the same device. Absent EPON slots that return 0 are skipped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Device memory utilization from Topvision CCMTS topCcmtsSysRAMRatio (0-100) or EPON board memory computed as used=(total*1024*1024-free)/(total*1024*1024) from topSysBdlMemSize (MB) and topSysBdFreeMemSize (bytes). Rows with total=0 are skipped.

metrics.name: device_flash_usage
metrics.description: CCMTS flash utilization from topCcmtsSysFlashRatio (0-100), averaged across indexed rows when the CCMTS system table is present.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest temperature in degrees Celsius from CCMTS equipment sensors (DDR, BCM3218, supply), EPON board topSysBdCurrentTemperature, or EPON PSU AC temperature. Absent or zero readings are skipped.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: EPON fan speed from topSysFanSpeed, reported in revolutions per second (rps). The maximum across fan indexes is used. Zero readings from empty fan rows are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
